items.summary: Delhi Police's Wednesday statement says Das, Ranka and Shinde were arrested under preventive provisions citing alleged repeated attempts to disturb public peace, violate the law, and instigate others through social media. Police detail the Oct 13 morning incident: the three plus 11 CJP members entered the denotified Jantar Mantar via private premises; all 14 detained; two FIRs registered (No. 289/26 at Connaught Place PS under BNSS secs 223(a), 332, 61(2); No. 128/26 at Parliament Street PS under 221, 115(2), 132, 121(1), 3(5)). Produced before the SEM Mandir Marg under BNSS 126/170; Das and Ranka remanded to 5 days' JC on apprehension they would repeat violations and instigate others if bailed; Shinde bound down for SIX MONTHS to maintain peace on personal bond + Rs 5,000 surety. Dipke's first reaction: 'Since when has hoisting the Tricolour become such a grave sin...?' — accuses the govt of an 'unofficial Emergency'. AAP leader Saurabh Bhardwaj called the remand 'DICTATORSHIP' on X; defense counsel Abhisht Hela questioned the legal basis of the preventive action, alleging suppression of dissent.
items.title: Delhi Police releases official statement on CJP arrests: cites social-media instigation; FIR numbers, Shinde's 6-month bind-down revealed
